## 0.0.330 - 2025-09-29

- Changed the default model back to Sonnet 4 since Sonnet 4.5 hasn't rolled out to all users yet. Sonnet 4.5 is still available from the `/model` slash command

This is our second release today -- be sure to check out [the list of changes in 0.0.329](https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/tag/v0.0.329) if you haven't already!
